name: AgentIF
description: AgentIF is the first benchmark for systematically evaluating large language models' instruction following ability in agentic scenarios. It features realistic, long, and complex instructions collected from 50 real-world agentic applications, annotated with constraints and multiple evaluation metrics including code-based and LLM-based evaluations.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for agentic instruction following that is gaining attention in research on long-horizon LLM agents but is not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Instructions average 1,723 words with complex constraints; includes hybrid code-LLM evaluation metrics.
